text:
nina: FYI ran into a weird worker-only failure when trying to onboard a customer with the JS SDK. auth header dropped on redirect + the retry path double-sends without auth.
harry: that sounds like a platform mismatch. are you bundling Node polyfills? Workers are web standard runtime — no Node globals.
leo: also check ESM/CJS entry points. wrangler/vite sometimes resolve the node entry which pulls in our node-only retry helper. we should expose a dedicated web entrypoint and types.
nina: repro: wrangler 3 + vite + sdk 0.14. build works but runtime throws: "ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined" and logs show an initial POST with Authorization then a 302 Location; follow-up request has no Authorization.
harry: redirect behavior is fetch spec: if redirect from one origin to another, user-agent should drop the Authorization. Our retry flow must be reconstructing requests incorrectly.
leo: suggested fixes: 1) publish an explicit web/edge ESM build and point to it via package exports (e.g., "./web": "./dist/esm/web.mjs"); 2) split typings so worker projects don't get Node types; 3) write an edge-aware retry adapter that clones the original Request and only retries idempotent methods.
pat: small snippet that helped me (Request cloning preserves headers if done before body is consumed):
```js
// inside retry adapter
const attempt = async (req) => {
  const r = new Request(req, { method: req.method, headers: req.headers });
  return fetch(r);
};
```
pat: plus make sure bundlers don't polyfill `global.Buffer` or other node stuff; those polyfills sometimes break feature detection.
leo: for types: add types/web.d.ts with lib.dom references and conditional exports in package.json so TS picks web types on that import path.
nina: i'll open a small repro and add a docs blurb in devex onboarding: "Edge runtimes: import from 'redwood-sdk/web' or ensure bundler picks browser field; avoid node polyfills; use edge retry adapter."
bot-ci: build queued - nina/worker-repro (sha: d41f3)
harry: also add a wrangler smoke test to CI to catch these earlier.
pat: we'll want a migration note for customers who currently depend on auto polyfills. add an example vite config snippet to strip node polyfills.
leo: ok assigning tasks: harry packaging + web build, pat retry adapter, alex (cc) types split, nina will make repro + docs.
nina: thanks all, will post links once PRs ready.
